method: Rules of qualify_ingestion.py applied by hand to the PDF bytes of pack/*.pdf (no shell available, script not executed). Counts marked approx were counted by hand.

pages.notes: Cites Table 2 of the Design SPD, which is not on this page; see table-page.pdf.
Text layer is a running header; body is a 120x160 8-bit grey raster drawn at 475x700 pt. Body is UNREAD: no OCR or vision available. Never pass as a text page. Perfect alnum ratio does not rescue it.

pages.chars: approx 205-280 depending on extractor (caption and cell separators)
pages.notes: Cells are placed individually; row reconstruction needed (header + 3 rows, 'see note 2' joins 'Note 2: within 400 m of a frequent bus stop the standard reduces by 1 space.'). The '400 m' is a bus-stop distance, not a drawing dimension. Route is 'both' because of the table hint, not the char count.

pages.vector_drawing_ops: 10 counted by hand; generator inventory says 14 (both >= 8)
pages.notes: '6.0 m' is a text label beside a dimension line; which element it measures is a visual fact not established here. '10 m' is the scale-bar end label, not a building dimension. No pixel estimate made; any later one must be labelled pixel_estimate with the 1:200 @ A3 assumption.
